verdict.rationale: Devin ships a documented public API: an API reference overview for integrating Devin into applications and automating workflows, including creating sessions on behalf of org users via create_as_user_id. The llms.txt index also lists a large API documentation section. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), detailed endpoint coverage in the evidence beyond session creation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
